objections.quote: You know what? It will be, sir, because, before this divorce I had a a A 760 credit score. And right now, it's set in just about, 625.
objections.reasoning: This is a hard qualifier gate (credit below 670) rather than a persuadable objection, and the rep correctly did not attempt to argue or work around it — the schema's current hard_dq rule makes this a DQ, not an objection to overcome. The open question of whether setters should DQ on stated credit at all versus deferring to the closer's bureau pull is a policy item for Kenny, not a rep performance gap.
